target: Owners and marketing leads of growing businesses that sell on looks and trust: hotels and lodges, real estate, clinics, restaurants and cafes, fashion and beauty brands, schools
where: Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana, South Africa first; UAE and Saudi Arabia second; anywhere else third. Scrolling Instagram on a phone.

behaviours.name: Trust-checker
